title: dashboard-spec
body: A few decisions about the dashboard.

questions.question: Q5. Example data ('preview' / the Trial version of the dashboard): what is it for?

options.label: A labelled tour: an 'Example PC' banner everywhere, plus a 'Connect my PC' button
Developer-only: users never see example data; no PC means 'Waiting for PC'
Only as a fallback when the PC can't be reached, always labelled
